mutations.name: a live occupant does not own the tree
kills: a worktree someone is standing in is held for a successor spawned with worktree: on the predecessor tree, and prune leaves it

mutations.name: grace runs from the newest row
mutations.replace: const exitedAt: number | undefined = stoppedAt(agent) === undefined ? undefined : agent.lastEventAt;
kills: finding what nobody is using times the grace window from the exit, not from a later row such as a refused retire

mutations.name: a live tree is re-judged by its files alone
kills: finding what nobody is using leaves a worktree alone while its agent is still running

mutations.name: reclaim ignores the sweep's status
kills: reclaiming refuses anything the sweep did not call reclaimable

mutations.name: reclaim keeps the allocation
kills: reclaiming removes the worktree, deletes the branch, and forgets the allocation
